purpose: Numeric input with locale-aware formatting, min and max bounds, and step increments emitting a number or null.
useWhen: Collecting a bounded numeric value such as a quantity, price, or age.
Needing locale-aware display formatting on top of a native number input.

avoidWhen.reason: Selecting a value within a continuous range visually — use slider instead.
Collecting free-form text or non-numeric content — use input instead.
